_doc: Curated card lore notes for scripts/build_card_enrichment.py (Bot cycles 33–34, Phase 8, #100). Key = exact card name. relation: depicts | references | echoes (echoes = mechanics mirror a cited moment; guidance). Every note cites official (wizards.com) pages; every double-quoted passage must be verbatim in a cited cached page (checked by build_card_enrichment.py --check). flag: optional ⚠️ / 🚫.

Godsend.text: Heliod "reforged the sword into the spear Godsend"; Elspeth later "stabbed Xenagos with Godsend, destroying him once and for all"

Blackblade Reforged.text: the weapon the *Dominaria* (2018) heroes seek: "So this Blackblade would kill Belzenlok."

The Mightstone and Weakstone.text: the two halves of the stone the brothers split; *The Brothers' War* episode 5 ends with "Mightstone and Weakstone, reunited at last, within the surviving brother."

Helvault.text: Avacyn's prison: Griselbrand would "trap her in the Helvault", and "When the Helvault shattered, Avacyn emerged at her full strength."

The Immortal Sun.text: the Sun Empire's lost relic: "Emperor Apatzec Intli was gifted the Immortal Sun in a fateful encounter, and vowed to conquer the merfolk and raze the jungle."

Golgothian Sylex.text: the artifact behind the Sylex Blast; in *Dominaria* (2018) Karn says "It was created by Urza to help defeat the Phyrexians." Later stories give other origins (see the item entry's three statements)

Moonsilver Key.text: "the Sungold Lock in the center of the Celestus needs to be joined with an enchanted, blessed-silver item called the Moonsilver Key", and "the Moonsilver Key has been lost for generations"

Crucible of the Spirit Dragon.text: "Narset and the other rebellion leaders gathered at the remains of the Crucible of the Spirit Dragon, hoping to finally put an end to the dragonlords' reign."

Hedron Archive.text: Zendikar's hedrons: "Ancient, rune-carved monoliths called hedrons are strewn across Zendikar."

The World Tree.text: Kaldheim's World Tree: "Looming overhead is the unfathomably huge bulk of the World Tree, whose dangling roots plunge into the realm." (Istfell)

Halo Fountain.text: New Capenna's Halo: the archangels "gave themselves up to make Halo, to distribute it across the city and throughout the air itself"

Halo Forager.text: New Capenna's Halo: the archangels "gave themselves up to make Halo, to distribute it across the city and throughout the air itself"
